title: A Non-Autonomous Model for Parabolic Implosion
summary: Orthogonal polynomials appear naturally in the study of compositions of Möbius transformations. In this paper, we consider several classes of orthogonal polynomials associated to non-autonomous perturbations of a parabolic Möbius map. Our results can be viewed as instances of non-autonomous parabolic implosion, including a random perturbative regime in which convergence holds almost surely.
